title.narrative: Global Quality and Standards Programme, Philippines: Standards and conformity assessment for personal protective equipment and medical devices

description.narrative: High-level discussions with Department of Trade and Industry, the Department of Science and Technology (DOST), industry chambers and associations, and other government representatives forming the UNIDO # convened Multi-stakeholder Working Group on COVID-19 stressed the urgent need for UNIDO to provide the necessary support build capacity and quality infrastructure for the local production and testing of PPEs at the required volume to meet the demands of healthcare facilities and the vulnerable population, complying with required production, safety, and quality standards.
